content.about: Lithuania is the largest of the three Baltic states, with forests, lakes and a sandy coast. The Curonian Spit has some of Europe's highest moving dunes. Vilnius has a baroque old town. Basketball is its national passion.

standout.text: Lithuanian is one of the oldest living Indo-European languages, close to ancient Sanskrit in some ways.

didYouKnow: Lithuania was the first Soviet republic to declare independence, in 1990.
The Hill of Crosses has more than 100,000 crosses.
Basketball is often called Lithuania's second religion.
